environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. Environment variables ADMIN_PASSWORD and USER_PASSWORD are set via AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store (SecureString) and injected at container start. lodash@4.17.20 installed. No request body schema validation middleware. ALB health check configured on /api/health. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.secrets_management: SSM Parameter Store, fetched at boot
